about: Package weight and size averages per leaf category, given by the operator (never made up). A row: category_id, category_name, fields (low / central / high of product_weight_g, package_weight_g, package_length_mm, package_width_mm, package_height_mm), approved_by, approved_at (YYYY-MM-DD), reliability (estimated_average: the weakest level), basis. A new or changed row raises version.

rows.basis: Median (central) and about the 10th / 90th percentile (low / high) of the naver-harvester's AI estimates on the 55 fairwardgolf full sets that have one in Shopify (read 2026-11-05; none seller-stated; sets with and without a bag together).
